notes.title: v1.0.3 PC Version Now Available!
notes.notes:
I've now completed the PC version of 1.0.3. I'm now investigating the Mac and Linux builds as well but you can now download the new v1.0.3 edition and start playing!

UPDATES:
-BRAND NEW BATTLE SYSTEM! Now with better attacks & better battle overall!
-Localization System, translaged (Google Translation) WITH 14 LANGUAGES TO CHOOSE FROM!!
-Tutorial System
-New Mobile Controls System with Dynamic controls
-New Announcements System
-Added Gem collection system, you can now collect gems to use later in the future
-Upgraded and added new items to Episode 1
-Fixed several bugs that were submitted by users
+MANY MORE UPDATES! CHECK IN APP FOR ANNOUNCEMENTS!

Please join the discord channel to learn about the latest updates the fastest and connect directly with me in real time to provide feedback and ideas and even get sneak peeks behind the scenes! DISCORD => https://discord.gg/aHStdJ8TVZ
